Whitewashed villages, golden beaches, mountain trails and world-class watersports — Paros packs an incredible variety into one Cycladic island. Whether you have a weekend or a week, here are the best things to do in Paros in 2026, from must-see highlights to local hidden gems. Pro tip: most of these are far easier to reach with your own [rent a car in Paros](https://antiparosrentacar.com/paros-rent-a-car/).

![The picturesque fishing harbour of Naoussa village on Paros at golden hour.](/media/2026/06/paros-naoussa-village.png.webp)The picturesque fishing harbour of Naoussa village on Paros at golden hour.

## Explore the Villages of Paros

### Parikia

The island capital and main port, Parikia mixes a lively waterfront with a maze-like old town of whitewashed lanes, boutiques and the magnificent Byzantine church of Panagia Ekatontapyliani (the Church of 100 Doors).

### Naoussa

Once a humble fishing village, Naoussa is now the chic heart of Paros: a postcard harbour with a Venetian castle, excellent seafood tavernas and a buzzing nightlife scene.

### Lefkes and the mountain villages

Head inland to Lefkes, the former capital perched in the hills, with marble streets, shady squares and the historic Byzantine Road walking trail. Nearby Prodromos and Marpissa reward visitors with authentic Cycladic charm and few crowds.

## The Best Beaches in Paros

- Kolymbithres — surreal smooth granite rock formations and turquoise coves near Naoussa.
- Golden Beach (Chrissi Akti) — a long sandy stretch and a world-famous windsurfing spot.
- Santa Maria — shallow, family-friendly water and beach bars.
- Monastiri — sheltered swimming inside the Paros Park area.
- Faragas — a scenic cove in the south, great for a quieter day.

![The unique granite rock formations and turquoise water of Kolymbithres beach, Paros.](/media/2026/06/paros-kolymbithres.png.webp)The unique granite rock formations and turquoise water of Kolymbithres beach, Paros.

## Watersports and Windsurfing

Paros is a Mediterranean watersports legend. The reliable summer _meltemi_ winds make Golden Beach and New Golden Beach prime spots for windsurfing and kitesurfing for all levels. Read our dedicated guide to [windsurfing in Paros](https://antiparosrentacar.com/windsurf-paros-car-rental-antiparos/) to plan your sessions.

## Day Trip to Antiparos

No visit is complete without the short hop to [Antiparos](https://antiparosrentacar.com/antiparos-island/). Explore the dramatic Cave of Antiparos, relax on uncrowded beaches, and wander the cosy main town. The car ferry from Pounta takes just 7 minutes — see our [Antiparos island guide](https://antiparosrentacar.com/rent-a-car-antiparos-aggelos/) for ideas.

![A quiet sandy beach with a traditional fishing boat and white chapel on Antiparos.](/media/2026/06/antiparos-beach.png.webp)A quiet sandy beach with a traditional fishing boat and white chapel on Antiparos.

## Food, Culture and Sunsets

- Taste fresh seafood, local cheeses and Parian wine at a harbour-side taverna.
- Visit the Church of 100 Doors, one of the oldest churches in Greece.
- Walk the Byzantine Road from Lefkes for sweeping island views.
- Catch the sunset from Parikia’s waterfront or a hilltop village.

## Why a Car Makes Paros Better

Most of Paros best beaches, villages and viewpoints are spread across the island and poorly served by bus. A rental car turns a long list of highlights into an easy, spontaneous itinerary. Compare vehicles on our [car fleet](https://antiparosrentacar.com/car-fleet/) page, consider an [SUV for Paros](https://antiparosrentacar.com/suv-rentals-paros/) if you want extra space, and read the [ultimate Paros travel guide](https://antiparosrentacar.com/ultimate-travel-guide-to-paros-greece-updated-for-2025/) for a full itinerary.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is Paros known for?**

Paros is famous for its charming villages like Naoussa and Parikia, beautiful beaches such as Kolymbithres and Golden Beach, world-class windsurfing, fine Parian marble, and a relaxed atmosphere with fewer crowds than Mykonos or Santorini.

**What are the best beaches in Paros?**

Top beaches include Kolymbithres for its rock formations, Golden Beach for windsurfing, Santa Maria for families, Monastiri in Paros Park, and Faragas in the south.

**How many days do you need in Paros?**

Three to four days lets you enjoy the main villages, several beaches and a day trip to Antiparos. A week is ideal if you want to relax and explore at a slower pace.

**Is Paros good for families?**

Yes. Paros has shallow, sheltered beaches like Santa Maria, family-friendly tavernas and easy distances, especially with a rental car for carrying beach gear.

**Do you need a car to explore Paros?**

You can use buses for the main towns, but a rental car is the best way to reach the island's beaches, mountain villages and hidden coves on your own schedule.
